title: Can Freelance Visa Sponsor Family in Dubai? All You Need To Know
description: Explore a freelance visa can sponsor your family in Dubai. Learn about the requirements, process, and benefits of family sponsorship.

breadcrumb.name: Can Freelance Visa Sponsor Family in Dubai? All You Need To Know

contentHtml:
Gone are the days when dedicated expats wait for employers to sponsor them in the UAE. For them, the UAE is a hub of opportunities to discover. Every individual once in a lifetime has a dream to explore it. However, to get this opportunity without the need for company sponsorship. Individuals are nowadays more concerned about availing of the freelance visa. We can’t deny the several benefits that freelance visas offer to the visa holder. The list is quite long! Interestingly, in this blog we have covered the top-of-the-list advantage. That is, through freelance visas, can freelance visa sponsor family.

The individual who always wants to make his/her family unite under one roof can achieve this now by having a freelance visa in Dubai.

Yes, you heard it right! With freelance visa on your hand, you can sponsor your company without any hassle. No company sponsorship is required, as you’re your own boss.

So, next time when you have this question in mind can freelance visa sponsor family? Then you should know that it’s easier than you think!

In this article, we cover every single detail that you are looking to sponsor your family in a single go!

Let’s delve into the details.

An Overview of Freelance Visa Sponsor Family in Dubai

Firstly, you need to understand what is a freelance visa. A freelance visa is a residence visa type that allows individuals to become self-employed. They can work professionally in certain sectors. They don’t need any company to sponsor them. Additionally, no office space is required in their case.

Besides of the many benefits, the freelance visa also provide the opportunity to its holder to sponsor their family.

By obtaining the freelance visa, you can have a chance to start residing in Dubai. The luxury that you always dreamt of, the living standard that you desire for your family, the state-of-the-art amenities. All and more can now become achievable by taking a single step forward. That is obtaining your freelance visa Dubai sponsor family!

Still have a doubt can freelance visa sponsor family? Hold on while we uncover more details.

Benefits of Sponsoring Family on Freelance Visa

There are several benefits of having a freelance visa Dubai. A few are discussed below:

Flexibility to work:

The freelance visa gives you the flexibility to work for multiple companies at a time. If you don’t want to grind in 9-5 and plan to work independently, then becoming a freelance in Dubai could be your best move!

Affordability:

The cost of obtaining a freelance visa is depending on the package you opt for. Many companies are providing cost-effective setup costs allowing you to offer your services cheaply. It helps you enter the freelance market. For this, you don’t need any office space

Work Independently:

Ready to start your journey as a freelancer in Dubai? Know that you can work as an independent contractor for companies around the UAE. Also, you can have access to the Dubai free zone centers.

Family Sponsorship:

This is the best of all. With a freelance visa, you can sponsor your family member to join you in Dubai. No employer sponsorship is needed for this.

Family Visa in Dubai?

The family visa in Dubai is an immigration document for families who want to move to the UAE. The family visa allows the resident’s family members to reside and work in the UAE.

Requirements For Sponsorship Family in Dubai

The process of family sponsorship in Dubai is simple if you meet certain requirements. First, you must have a valid residence permit/visa. Also, you need to meet the specific financial criteria. Here is the list of requirements:

  • A residence visa is necessary to sponsor your family in Dubai. Work visas also help you in sponsoring your family. The work visa can be obtained by your employer or a self-sponsored visa such as an Investor Visa, Green Visa, or Golden visa respectively.
  • It is essential for you to earn between AED 3000 to AED 4000 to sponsor your family in Dubai along with the accommodation.
  • According to the UAE’s new policy, the residents can now sponsor many family members. They can sponsor their parents or their spouse’s parents. Individuals can do so without having a job.
  • The sponsors must have a suitable place to live in. They should have a property with at least two bedrooms.

Procedure for Family visa

In the UAE, the application process for a family visa can vary from case to case. Typically, it involves the following steps:

  1. First, you need to gather all the necessary documents. It includes marriage certificates, passport copies, financial documents, and birth certificates. (Digital copies can be submitted).
  2. Secondly, you need to submit your application with the gathered documents through government channels.
  3. At this stage, your family has to undergo a medical examination to ensure their good health.
  4. For Emirates ID cards, you need to submit another application.
  5. On application approval, your family will receive the residency visa.
  6. Family visas need to be renewed periodically.

Next time, if you have this question can freelance visa sponsor family, then you are advised to go through this article again!

Required Documents

As long as you match the criteria, you can bring your family to live with you. If you are a male and a legal resident of the UAE while meeting the financial criteria, you only need the below documents to gather your family:

  • You have to submit a family sponsorship application. You can submit it online or in person.
  • Passport copies of wife and children are required.
  • Your wife and children’s photos.
  • The medical clearance certificate is required for residents above 18 years of age.
  • Copy of your job contract.
  • The salary certificate from the employer that indicates your monthly salary.
  • Marriage certificate.

Medical Test for Family Members

Medical test is required to perform for family members when sponsoring them on freelance visas. It is just a simple assessment by a doctor. It includes a simple blood test and a chest x-ray. The family members are screened for communicable diseases such as hepatitis, HIV, tuberculosis, and, leprosy syphilis.

Your Valid Emirates ID

As a freelance visa holder, you can receive an Emirates ID. The Emirates ID is an identity card issued by the Federal Authority for identity. This is beneficial for you to use government services.

Your passport or residence permit

To sponsor your family in Dubai, you must have a valid passport with 6 months validity. On the other hand, you are also required to have a residence permit UAE, either by company or an individual.

Sponsoring Your Children, Attested Birth Certificates

Birth certificate attestation is required in sponsoring your children in Dubai if your children are born in UAE or any other country. The attestation is required to obtain a resident visa in the UAE.

Processing Timeline

The visa process can take up to 10 to 30 days. However, it can be exceeded depending on your case requirements.

Conclusion

In conclusion, the dream of expats to unite their families has now become possible with a freelance visa in Dubai. However, it is necessary to meet the requirements and consider them closely to avoid any difficulty that may arise in obtaining a freelance visa. From financial considerations to having a residence permit and others. The process to obtain a freelance visa is easier than you think. Make sure to complete the required document list as briefly discussed in this blog. We believe that you have got the answer to your query now can freelance visa sponsor family? Need more assistance on this topic or others? You can message us or call us anytime!

FAQs

Can a freelance visa holder sponsor a family in Dubai?

As a freelance visa holder, you can sponsor your family. However, you must meet the requirements.

What is the minimum salary required to sponsor a family on a freelance visa?

There is no specific minimum salary requirement for this visa type.

Which family members can be sponsored on a freelance visa in Dubai?

Under a freelance visa, spouse, children, and in some cases, parents can be sponsored.

What documents are required to sponsor a family on a freelance visa?

These documents are required to sponsor a family on a freelance visa:

  • Passport copies
  • Marriage certificate
  • Birth certificates
  • Ejari, and
  • Salary proof

How long does family visa processing take in Dubai?

The family visa process takes 1 to 3 weeks after medical tests and document submission.

Is a medical test mandatory for family members sponsored on a freelance visa?

Medical fitness tests are mandatory for adult family members.
